title: Maximum residue level for ethofumesate
summary: EU to increase ethofumesate MRL on carrots
update: The European Union (EU) will raise the maximum residue level (MRL) for ethofumesate on carrots from 0.03 to 0.1 mg/kg. This follows a positive evaluation of safety for consumers by the European Food Safety Authority.
what_changing: The EU will increase the MRL for ethofumesate on carrots from 0.03 (the limit of determination, LOD) to 0.1 mg/kg. (The LOD is the lowest level that can be detected using the most modern and reliable analytical methods.)
why: Following an application for a change of MRLs by the producer of ethofumesate, the European Food Safety Authority has concluded that increasing the MRL would not pose a risk for consumers ( EFSA 2026 ).
timeline: The new MRL is expected to apply from early 2027.
background: MRLs are set in accordance with the rules set out in Regulation 396/2005 . For information on current MRLs for other substances, please consult the EU Pesticide Residues database .
resources: EFSA (2026) Modification of the existing maximum residue level for ethofumesate in carrots . EFSA Journal, 24(7): e10188.
